kpi.settingsLocation: visProp.fmt (also node.vp) — short property codes, JSON-in-string values

dropZones.Trend (zoneId 20): optional attribute -> sparkline + previous-period value + change badge
dropZones.Break By (zoneId 5): optional attribute -> one card per element

settings.dm: display mode: '5' = single card, '1' = cards per Break By element
settings.gcc: grid column count / cards per view ('1' single, '3' for the Break By example)
settings.tst: '1' on single and Break By examples (title/label shown)
settings.smn: 'true' = show metric name with the element ('Revenue - Technology') on Break By cards
settings.ks: 'custom' = use the custom card scheme in cks
settings.cks: JSON array: [{ id:'custom', name:'Customize', bgColor, bgOpacity, chartColor, chartOpacity }] — card background and sparkline color
settings.nfts: JSON: fonts per part — label, primary_value, previous_value, trend_identity: { fc (color), fw (bold), ff (family), us } — keep previous_value to {fc} only: adding fst/fw rendered the previous-period text struck through

kpi.insert: s.insertKpiCard({newKey, layout}) — copyUnit + createDefaultDropZones widgetType 9 + Visualization KPICardVisualizationStyle (IPad IPhoneKPICardStyle) + ClassName KPICardApplicationViewer, displayMode 1
kpi.settingsWriter: s.setKpiCardProps(key, {dm, gcc, tst, smn, ks, cks, nfts}) — objects are JSON-serialized

comparison_kpi.settingsLocation: node.vp.cvp.properties (JSON string, 79 keys) — same plugin-style blob as Iconic KPI

dropZones.Break By (zoneId 5): optional attribute -> one card per element

settings.layoutType: 0 single, 1 carousel (Break By), 2 grid of cards (Multi-Metric)
settings.secondaryMetricName: label shown before the target value ('Revenue Target')
settings.comparisonIndicatorEnabled: true -> show the variance vs target
settings.selectedReferenceLine: optional reference line on the trend chart

comparison_kpi.settingsWriter: s.setKpiProperties(key, props) — a partial properties object is enough; omitted keys keep the defaults

dropZones.Trend (zoneId 5): period attribute for the sparkline + previous period (the editor labels it Trend; the definition calls it BreakBy)

examples.title: Comparison Break By

verified.how: build-kpi-showcase.js rebuilt all seven variants on Shared Studio › Business Insurance Claims Analytics (Payment Amount = actual, Initial Reserve Amount = target, Payment Date (Quarter) = period, Region = category) in 6.6 s; saved as 'zz KPI Showcase v1' in My Reports. Each card rendered like its demo counterpart and its values matched a reference grid.
verified.editorDefaults: The editor writes the full 80-key Comparison/Multi-Metric properties blob when a field is first added (setProperty prs FormattingWidget pri 4). Code only needs the keys it changes.
